fileShare.title: Share “{{name}}”
fileShare.description: They get this file's own key, never its folder's. They see only this file.
fileShare.recipientHint: Someone with an account on this server.
fileShare.canEditHint: They can change it and save versions. Without this they can only view it. Only you can rename, move or delete it.
fileShare.note: Sharing again with the same person changes what they can do.
fileShare.notFound: No one on this server has that email. Files cannot be shared with other servers yet.
fileShare.failed: The file could not be shared.
fileShare.loadFailed: Could not load who has access.
fileShare.empty: Only people who can open its folder can open this file.
fileShare.confirmBody: They lose access now, and the file moves to a new key they never get: nothing changed from now on is readable to them. What they already opened or downloaded stays with them.
fileShare.changed: Who has access changed meanwhile. Check the list and try again.
fileShare.removeFailed: Access could not be removed. Try again.
